title: A Smooth Nonquadratic Entire Affine Maximal Graph in Dimension Ten
summary: We construct a smooth nonquadratic entire graph in dimension ten that solves the classical affine maximal equation and has positive-definite Hessian everywhere. This gives a smooth counterexample to the entire-graph affine Bernstein assertion in dimension ten. Hessian positivity is pointwise; no global uniform lower bound or completeness of the Berwald–Blaschke metric is asserted.
family_title: Affine Bernstein rigidity through dimension nine and a smooth dimension-ten counterexample
